purpose: tighten BDUK classification/current_gigabit/future_gigabit/RFS semantics before any parcel migration

facts: White means no gigabit infrastructure and none likely within 3 years
Grey means one qualifying gigabit infrastructure available or planned within 3 years
Black means two or more qualifying infrastructures available or planned within 3 years
Under Review can include unverified current claims or planned build with remaining risk/evidence gaps
In build means premises cannot yet take service
RFS means build/testing complete and service can be ordered/provisioned within standard timescales
postcode and UPRN outputs will be published after evaluation

official_web_findings.source: BDUK January 2026 UPRN release technical note
facts: current_gigabit derives from BDUK OMR and delivery data
post-January connections may not be TRUE
not all suppliers return, causing gaps
future_gigabit derives only from BDUK OMR
BDUK OMR is not directly comparable with Ofcom PND due to premises-base, supplier-set, methodology and reference-date differences
